history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure that the concerned entities prioritize filling P- 2 geographical posts by focusing on ageing vacant posts.
history.administration_response: The Administration continued, throughout 2024, to prioritize the recruitment of candidates from unrepresented and underrepresented Member States to fill positions in the young professionals programme. Between 8 May and 31 December 2024, the period following the acceptance of the audit recommendation, 39 external candidates were selected for the programme, of which 2 were from unrepresented countries and 37 were from underrepresented countries. This demonstrates that the referenced practice is now being followed. On the basis of the action taken, the Administration requests the closure of this recommendation by the Board.
history.board_assessment: Given that all external candidates recruited in 2024 are from unrepresented or underrepresented countries, and that recruitment efforts focused on ageing vacant posts, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
